title: Indian Pursuit Dark Horse Tourer
description: The Harley-Davidson Indian Pursuit Dark Horse Tourer is engineered to turn 1,000km days into effortless armchair transits, positioned in the Luxury Grand Tourer segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 110 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. The cockpit is configured with an Upright Neutral riding stance and a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
